newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Earthquake shakes South Korean capital.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake shakes South Korean capital.

text.p: A rare earthquake shook the South Korean capital of Seoul on Friday but there were no immediate reports of injuries or damage, witnesses said.
There was also no immediate estimate of the size or epicentre of the earthquake which struck at about 1.15 p.m. (0415 GMT).
Seoul residents said the capital was rarely shaken by earth tremors and the telephone switchboard of the Meteorological Bureau which monitors seismic activity was jammed with calls.
The jolt was severe enough to rattle computers on desks in central Seoul office buildings.
